title: QSO-Zero
summary: QRP digital modes interface in your pocket.
description: A pocket FT8 / FT4 / JS8 / WSPR station for the M5Stack Cardputer Zero, built for QRP operators in the field. It's plain C with no desktop: it draws straight to the Cardputer's screen, controls the radio through Hamlib, and decodes and transmits on its own. Please visit github.com/CzarD0mn/QSO-Zero for installation instructions as dependancies must be installed before this app can install properly.
